summary.result: Results showed that N₂O emission rates were significantly related with soil water status and soil available N contents.
summary.background: We aimed at investigating the difference in N₂O emission factors of chemical and organic fertilizers and identifying the main factors influencing annual fluctuations in N₂O emission.
summary.method: Significant correlation between % water filled pore space (WFPS) and N₂O emission was observed only when the %WFPS was greater than 40% and during the initial stage of the experiment (＜60 d).
